description: This source file is a command-line program for generating files used in crash cache unit tests for the Chromium project. It includes functions to create cache files, simulate crashes, and manage test scenarios, primarily for debugging purposes in a development environment.

methods.name: RunSlave
methods.description: Starts a new process to generate crash cache files based on the specified crash scenario.

methods.name: MasterCode
methods.description: Main loop for executing crash scenarios sequentially.

methods.name: CreateTargetFolder
methods.description: Creates a specific folder for a crash scenario if it does not already exist.

methods.name: FlushQueue
methods.description: Ensures all pending cache operations are completed.

methods.name: CreateCache
methods.description: Initializes a cache instance with specified parameters.

methods.name: SimpleInsert
methods.description: Creates cache files with a simple insert scenario.

methods.name: SimpleRemove
methods.description: Creates cache files with a removal scenario.

methods.name: HeadRemove
methods.description: Creates cache files with a head removal scenario.

methods.name: LoadOperations
methods.description: Creates cache files simulating heavy load operations.
